source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The tray asks mozILocaleService for app locale identifiers, but its resource loader compile-includes the en-US menubar and branding files. That is not proof that the app locale translations are loaded. Current code adds FluentBundleRc and Gecko adaptation for functions such as PLATFORM; it also uses the system-tray-menuitem-quit message value rather than the historical .label attribute. Preserve the distinction between locale rules, resource text and custom Fluent functions. The later adapter change was checked only as current source, not counted as a fully studied later bug.
title: Separate locale selection from loading translated resources
